{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011Ccs2EP4vrSbMYS9TPUfyf","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01JTBn19Xj87afVerokzFPM7","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 -c \"\nimport csv, math\nfrom datetime import datetime\nimport answer as a\nfrom collections import defaultdict\n\nrows = []\nwith open('/app/dataset/data.csv', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:\n    reader = csv.DictReader(f)\n    for idx, row in enumerate(reader):\n        record_id = row['record_id']\n        event_time = a.parse_event_time(row['event_time'])\n        region = row['region']\n        channel = row['channel'].strip().lower()\n        base_amount = a.parse_amount(row['amount_str'])\n        items, adj_pct, fee, waive = a.parse_notes(row['notes'])\n        if math.isnan(base_amount):\n            net = float('nan')\n        else:\n            net = base_amount*(1+adj_pct)+fee\n            if waive: net = 0.0\n        rows.append({'order': idx, 'record_id': record_id, 'event_time': event_time, 'region': region, 'channel': channel, 'items': items, 'net': net})\n\nbest = {}\nfor r in rows:\n    rid = r['record_id']\n    if rid not in best:\n        best[rid] = r; continue\n    cur = best[rid]\n    def et_key(et): return (et is not None, et)\n    if et_key(r['event_time']) != et_key(cur['event_time']):\n        if et_key(r['event_time']) > et_key(cur['event_time']): best[rid] = r\n        continue\n    cur_real = not math.isnan(cur['net']); new_real = not math.isnan(r['net'])\n    if new_real != cur_real:\n        if new_real and not cur_real: best[rid] = r\n        continue\n    if r['order'] < cur['order']: best[rid] = r\n\ndedup_rows = list(best.values())\nstart = datetime.fromisoformat('2025-10-01T00:00:00+00:00')\nend = datetime.fromisoformat('2025-12-31T23:59:59+00:00')\nfiltered = [r for r in dedup_rows if r['event_time'] and start <= r['event_time'] <= end and r['channel']!='phone' and not math.isnan(r['net']) and not math.isinf(r['net'])]\n\ngroups = defaultdict(list)\nfor r in filtered:\n    groups[(r['region'], r['event_time'].strftime('%Y-%m'))].append(r)\n\nfor key, grp in groups.items():\n    nets = [g['net'] for g in grp]\n    med = a.median(nets)\n    m = a.mad(nets, med)\n    for g in grp:\n        g['robust_z'] = 0.0 if m==0 else 0.6745*(g['net']-med)/m\n\nfor r in filtered:\n    items_eff = max(r['items'] if r['items'] is not None else 1, 1)\n    r['items_eff'] = items_eff\n    r['anomaly_score'] = abs(r['robust_z'])*math.log1p(items_eff)\n\nranked = sorted(filtered, key=lambda r: (-r['anomaly_score'], -abs(r['robust_z']), -(r['event_time'].timestamp()), r['record_id']))\nfor r in ranked[:15]:\n    print(r['record_id'], r['region'], r['event_time'], r['net'], r['items'], r['items_eff'], round(r['robust_z'],4), round(r['anomaly_score'],4))\n\"\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":531,"cache_read_input_tokens":55896,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":531,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":6,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"65063bc4-9b8f-4366-9894-ad22d59db6e0","uuid":"feb08c9e-cf53-47ee-a0ba-af770654ec99","request_id":"req_011Ccs2ENREWWZB8sembsxzt"}
